scope.notes: Inventory in progress (175 rows). Covers Exalted: The Abyssals character-creation overview (Chapter Three), the universal Anima Effect available to every caste, all five Castes with their Anima Banners/Anima Effects/Caste Abilities/Associations, the Abyssal Curse, the Virtues of Death, the Resonance Trait (Abyssal Limit analog) including gain/loss/manifestation rules and the 1-10 Resonance Manipulation Effects table, the-title, Useful Crafts, the Cult-and-Abyssals exclusion sidebar, the six new deathknight-only Backgrounds (Abyssal Command, Liege, Necromancy, Spies, Underworld Manse, Whispers), the altered Backgrounds (Artifact, Backing/Mentor, Familiar, Followers, Manse), and now 148 Chapter Five Charm rows (pp. 157-200, PDF 158-201) covering every Ability line for the Dusk, Midnight and Daybreak Castes (Archery, two Brawl trees, Martial Arts, three Melee trees and Thrown for Dusk; two Endurance trees, Performance, Presence, Resistance and Survival for Midnight; Craft, Investigation, Lore, a two-sub-tree Medicine line, and Occult -- including the sorcery-access and necromancy-access Charms and a spirit-perception/spirit-combat line -- for Daybreak). The Day Caste (Athletics/Awareness/Dodge/Larceny/Stealth) and Moonshadow Caste (Bureaucracy/Linguistics/Ride/Sail/Socialize) Charm trees are not yet inventoried; Day Caste's Athletics tree begins immediately at printed p. 200/PDF 201.

sources.role: Primary Abyssal rules, Charms, Backgrounds, and setting material

rulesNotes: Printed page numbers in this book run 1 less than the PDF page number supplied (PDF page = printed page + 1) for the copy used to build this inventory; both are recorded on every citation. Confirmed again at the Chapter Five Day Caste boundary: the rendered PDF page 201 shows printed folio '200' at the bottom, matching this offset.
This PDF is image-based (no selectable text layer); all rows below were transcribed from rendered page images, per the 'OCR is an extraction aid, never verification by itself' rule.
Abyssals do not have a Limit Trait; Resonance (1-10) fills the equivalent role and is tracked/gained/lost differently. See the resonance-* inventory rows.

A small number of Chapter Five rows have summary text (copied from the book's own prose) that labels more than one Charm as a tree 'capstone' within the same Ability line, most notably in the Dusk Caste Melee material around attunement-shattering-block/eye-of-the-tempest, and the Daybreak Caste Medicine sub-tree numbering jumps from 'second' to 'third' without an identified second sub-tree in this pass. The per-row citations and mechanical content are still accurate to their page, but the exact tree-branch topology in those spots needs a dedicated disambiguation review before this content is promoted to a production catalog.
